opener_concept: Two identical-size blocks, one 20 g and one 60 g: student sees B has 3x the mass in the same space (answers 3, then 6 g/cm3 if A is 2), which is exactly density = mass / volume. Reveal names rho = m/V and nods to Delta-E = mc Delta-theta and E = mL.
